results.title: Louvre heist: Stolen jewellery worth €88m, prosecutor says
results.author: Aleks Phillips
highlights: Jewellery stolen from the Louvre in Paris in a daring daylight robbery has been valued at 88 million euros (£76m; $102m), a French public prosecutor has said, citing the museum's curator. Laure Beccuau told RTL radio the sum was "extraordinary" but said the greater loss was to France's historical heritage.
